answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 43 epochs of grading, and every reef settlement recomputes the relic schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 43 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
